topic: What antenna design considerations optimize ground station visibility during short service windows in LEO constellations?
consensus_response: Optimizing ground station visibility in LEO constellations requires balancing fading mitigation, transmit power management, and satellite geometry. Beamforming optimization, phased array antennas, and digital beamforming enhance signal quality, but introduce trade-offs between complexity, latency, and resource demands. Hybrid approaches can mitigate these issues.
reference_context: LEO constellations require multiple satellites for global coverage, with orbit altitude and inclination impacting dwell time and communication windows.
